vagas.title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Compensation Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. vagas.description: Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho. Suas principais atividades serão: Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada; Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento; Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica; Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações; Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações; Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica; Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia; Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica; Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica; Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória; Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado; Manter sala de imobilização organizada; Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade; Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual; Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados; Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes; Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento; Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. vagas.description: O Grupo Vitus nasceu em 2019 com o objetivo de expandir a nossa forma de cuidar e valorizar a saúde dos nossos pacientes, com o propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor. Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência no tratamento musculoesquelético. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos. Para se identificar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores: Somos uma empresa que está em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da história desta empresa que é referência no tratamento a pacientes com doenças musculo esquelético e terapia assistida. #SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor Conhecimento de pacote office; Curiosidade em aprender; Interesse em se desenvolver e assumir novos desafios. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.**The Role**Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. That’s The Kyndryl Way.**What You Can Expect**Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. vagas.title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
vagas.description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. vagas.title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos: O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura: A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade: Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Ponto de atenção: Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. vagas.title: Country Lead, Brazil
vagas.description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, and may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with applicable law. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Governança e Processos de TI com perfil analítico e focado em conformidade. O objetivo deste profissional será estruturar e monitorar as políticas de TI, garantindo que a administração de sistemas, o controle de acessos e o inventário de ativos sigam os padrões de segurança e eficiência operacional. Principais Responsabilidades: Gestão de Políticas e Normas: Elaborar, revisar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, uso de ativos e conformidade (TI General Controls). Desenho de Processos (ITSM): Mapear e otimizar processos críticos como Onboarding/Offboarding de colaboradores, gestão de mudanças e gestão de incidentes. Controle de Acessos (IAM): Definir a matriz de perfis de acesso e realizar revisões periódicas (auditorias) para garantir o princípio do privilégio mínimo. Gestão de Ativos (ITAM): Garantir a integridade do inventário de hardware e software, monitorando o ciclo de vida dos ativos e a conformidade de licenciamento (Compliance). Administração de Endpoints (Governança): Definir os padrões de configuração e segurança que devem ser aplicados aos dispositivos da empresa via ferramentas de MDM. Gestão de Indicadores (KPIs): Criar e monitorar dashboards de desempenho da TI, níveis de serviço (SLA) e aderência aos processos. Auditoria e Conformidade: Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias internas e externas, garantindo que as evidências de controle estejam sempre organizadas. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência em Governança de TI, Gestão de Serviços ou Compliance. Experiência em frameworks de mercado como ITIL. Conhecimento em metodologias de mapeamento de processos (BPMN). Familiaridade com conceitos de Segurança da Informação (ISO 27001) e LGPD. Visão técnica sobre administração de diretórios e ferramentas de inventário. Soft Skills (Habilidades Comportamentais): Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender como uma pequena mudança em um processo afeta toda a organização. Organização: Necessária para lidar com documentações, prazos de auditoria e inventários complexos. Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade para negociar a aplicação de políticas com diferentes áreas da empresa. Perfil Ético e Imparcial: Fundamental para realizar auditorias e garantir o cumprimento das regras. Crescimento das vendas, do lucro bruto, positivação, etc). ; Gerir os contratos de transporte em vigência nas operações de distribuição através do acompanhamento das negociações de reajuste de contrato conduzidas por Suprimentos; Geração de aditivos para adequação de escopo da operação; Renovação de contratos próximos a expirar; Implantar novos projetos visando a otimização de processos e informações (ganho de produtividade) dentro da área de Expedição e Distribuição através do desenvolvimento de melhorias dentro dos sistemas da cia com suporte de TI; Avaliação de novas tecnologias existentes e sua aplicabilidade na área; Benchmarking sobre melhores práticas de mercado.; Orientar e desenvolver a equipe de trabalho através do treinamento das atividades desempenhadas; Aplicação de feedback para os colaboradores; Comunicação frequente em relação às informações relevantes da área de Logística e demais setores. Participação nos lucros Assistência Médica / Medicina em grupo Convênio com farmácia Assistência Odontológica Vale alimentação Vale refeição Seguro de vida em grupo Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país. Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito. Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena. vagas.title: Sales Lead (Líder de Vendas) - Rio de Janeiro (Hybrid) Brasil
vagas.description: Ready to accelerate your career? Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale. Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices. We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas. What you'll do We're looking for a Sales Lead to spearhead our growth in Rio de Janeiro. In this role, you'll be instrumental in expanding Clara's footprint across both Mid-Market and Enterprise segments by identifying new business opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and driving revenue growth. Your contributions will directly impact our mission to revolutionize spend management for companies across Latin America. Key Responsibilities Drive Regional Sales Growth: Own and execute the end-to-end sales cycle for both scaling Mid-Market companies and complex Enterprise corporations in Rio de Janeiro. Leverage Local Network: Use your existing relationships and deep understanding of Rio de Janeiro's business ecosystem, especially among decision-makers in finance, operations, and procurement, to open doors and generate qualified leads. Manage Complex Deal Cycles: Navigate multi-stakeholder procurement and legal processes typical of Enterprise clients while maintaining a high-velocity pipeline for Mid-Market segments. Optimize the Sales Engine: Utilize tools like Hubspot , Metabase , Amplemarket , and N8N to manage your pipeline, automate workflows, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to consistently improve conversion rates. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product, risk, legal, and customer success teams via Slack and Google Drive to align market strategies, unblock complex deals, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new clients. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves Minimum 5 years of B2B sales experience managing a mix of Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Deep knowledge of the Rio de Janeiro corporate landscape and an active local network among finance leaders, CFOs, and key corporate decision-makers. Demonstrated capability to manage multi-stakeholder sales cycles, negotiate complex agreements, and interface confidently with C-level executives. Working proficiency in English and fluent Portuguese, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and optimize daily outreach. Adaptability to fast-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate independently. Nice to haves Experience selling complex SaaS, financial technology, ERP systems, or corporate card solutions. Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL , or Python to dive into pipeline metrics and market data. Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn it. A good sense of humor. Why join Clara At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who we are We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup . Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. What we offer Competitive salary and stock options ( ESOP ) from day one Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese , Spanish, and English (our corporate language) Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results At Clara, we’ll support your growth. If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Data de início da publicação: 24/04/2026 Localidade: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Que bom que nos encontramos! Deixa a gente se apresentar… Somos a MRS, uma empresa de logística que há quase 30 anos, junto com 20% de toda carga que é exportada no Brasil, transporta um pouco do talento de milhares de pessoas. Levamos em cada vagão os sonhos, as expectativas e os resultados alcançados por muita gente. Sempre com a clareza de que não se pode chegar a nenhum destino sozinho. Por isso, queremos conhecer você, que tem potencial para seguir com a gente e trilhar sua carreira com destino ao aprendizado e muitas realizações. Como será seu dia a dia? Será responsável pela execução de manutenções corretivas, preventivas e preditivas em: Componentes de locomotivas e vagões; Estruturas metálicas; Equipamentos industriais e dispositivos de apoio. Destmontagem, inspeção, ajuste, reaperto e montagem de componentes mecânicos e pneumáticos. Operação de máquinas, ferramentas, plataformas elevatórias e equipamentos de içamento, quando devidamente habilitado. Preenchimento e registro de relatórios de manutenção e atividades executadas. Participação ativa em treinamentos, DDS, reuniões de segurança e palestras técnicas. Cumprimento rigoroso das normas de segurança do trabalho, meio ambiente e segurança da informação. O que você precisa ter ou saber? Ensino Médio Completo Curso profissionalizante em Soldagem MIG ou MAG + Oxicorte (obrigatório). Conhecimentos básicos em: Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e diagramas; Noções de caldeiraria e metalurgia; Metrologia básica (medidas, instrumentos e tolerâncias). vagas.title: Brand Ambassador / Activation Manager, L43 - Rio, Brazil
vagas.description: The Activation Manager role represents a strategic transformation in how Zamora Company approaches the market. Moving beyond traditional brand advocacy, this position serves as a strategic partner to both On-Trade and Off-Trade channels, with a clear focus on driving sell-out, ensuring flawless execution of our brands across all touchpoints, and delivering measurable return on investment in the Rio region. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. This role is critical to advancing Zamora's ambition of building a best‑in‑class route-to-market and execution model in Brazil. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Monitor and master the AVQPAP execution standards (Availability, Visibility, Quality of Display, Price, Activation, Promotion) across the territory. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. Zamora Company is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Sobre a OceanPact A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando em áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore, com presença sólida em todo o território nacional. vagas.description: Overview FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Department: Commercial & Marketing Location: Brazil Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup Trophy Tour Manager will lead the planning, marketing and delivery of the Host Country phase of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour across Brazil, ensuring a cohesive, high‑impact and locally relevant execution across all Host Cities. They will also support moments on the Global Tour that require local stakeholders, in particular Brazilian Embassies in the 32 participating Member Associations. This role acts as the central point of coordination in‑market, driving alignment across FIFA’s global team in Zurich, local stakeholders and internal functions, working closely with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich. Key Responsibilities Strategy, planning & alignment Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities. Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact. Act as the primary point of contact for the eight Host Cities, coordinating planning, timelines, and delivery expectations. Ensure integration with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives. Stakeholder management & governance Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in‑market. Serve as the source of truth on local context, sensitivities and opportunities, proactively informing the global team. Lead cross‑functional coordination across FIFA internal teams (Operations, Legends, Digital, Communications, Brand, Partnerships, Media), ensuring all workstreams are aligned, integrated and delivered against a unified plan. Ensure consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich‑based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision‑making across global and local stakeholders. Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run of show, schedules and promotional activities. Ensure total compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments. Marketing, communications & content Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on‑the‑ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan. Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative. Inspire Host Cities and hosting stakeholders at a local level to invest resources to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events possible. Lead coordination of media activities in‑market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications. Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs, and social platforms). On‑site delivery & operations Represent FIFA on‑site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed. Oversee delivery of FIFA communications, promotional and content activities, ensuring high‑quality execution and stakeholder experience. Ensure proper representation, handling and protection of FIFA assets, including the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy and FIFA Legend. Coordinate on‑site stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, including media, partners and local teams. Reporting & performance tracking Monitor progress of the FIFA Trophy Tour across Host Cities and ensure timely escalation of risks or issues. Provide regular and comprehensive reporting on activities, performance and key learnings. Contribute to post‑event evaluation and recommendations for future FIFA Trophy Tours. Global coordination Support the Zurich‑based project team on the global leg where required. Coordinate with FIFA27 Government Relations to pitch the FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion in both phases of the FIFA Trophy Tour, to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities. Ensure continuity and consistency between the global and Host Country phases, capturing and sharing key learnings to inform delivery across the tour. Your profile Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing. Minimum of 5 years of work experience in Marketing and Events or Experiential projects, ideally within sport or major international events. Preferred previous experience in football and/or professional sports. Strong understanding of sports marketing, including sponsorship, brand communication and fan engagement. Proven ability to deliver integrated marketing communications and promotional campaigns across online and offline channels. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast‑paced and evolving environment. Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level. Demonstrated ability to work cross‑functionally, building strong relationships and aligning diverse teams towards a shared objective. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner. High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment. Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools e.g. Monday.com. Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Esperamos de Você: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharias, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas, com ao menos 2-3 anos de formado; Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma híbrida (3x por semana) no escritório em Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro; Mínimo de 3-4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados, com ao menos 2 anos focados em soluções de IA Generativa e LLMs em ambiente produtivo; Experiência prática em machine learning clássico e ciência de dados, com domínio de bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, ferramentas de experimentação, estatística e análise exploratória; Bom conhecimento de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural; Domínio de SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (DynamoDB); Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure), especialmente serviços serverless (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS); Sólida base em engenharia de software, com experiência em infraestrutura, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, boas práticas de programação; Experiência com Python como linguagem principal de desenvolvimento; Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não-técnicos, adaptando o nível de abstração conforme o interlocutor. Diferenciais: Experiência com modelos de Deep Learning e fine-tuning (TensorFlow ou PyTorch); Experiência combinando modelos determinísticos, ML clássico e LLMs em pipelines híbridos; Vivência em práticas de segurança aplicadas a sistemas de IA (controle de acesso, sanitização de inputs, proteção contra prompt injection, etc); Experiência com testes e estratégias de avaliação de modelos e pipelines de IA (evals, benchmarks, testes de regressão); Experiência com FastAPI e pipelines de CI/CD via Azure DevOps; Conhecimento de ferramentas de big data (Spark, Airflow); Experiência prática em inferência estatística e planejamento de experimentos; Conhecimentos sobre o funcionamento de fundos de investimento, incluindo sua estrutura, regulação e operação, aplicado a desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para o segmento; Inglês avançado; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição; Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida; Desconto em Farmácia; Programa de Nutrição; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais autônomos com perfil empreendedor, que tenham forte atuação comercial, experiência no mercado de crédito consignado e bastante networking, com foco em relacionamento e expansão de parceiros. O Gestor de Grandes Contas Externo atuará como prestador de serviços para expandir e fortalecer a presença da GVN e de seus parceiros nos mercados regionais, atuando de forma consultiva no relacionamento com correspondentes bancários, bancos e parceiros comerciais, por meio das visitas presenciais. Apresentar soluções financeiras e oportunidades de negócios alinhadas à estratégia da GVN. Realizar visitas presenciais para ampliar a base de parceiros. Conduzir o ciclo comercial completo, da prospecção ao fechamento, representando a empresa da melhor forma possível. Negociar contratos, margens, condições comerciais e prazos de pagamento, assegurando a rentabilidade da carteira. 2. Gestão de relacionamento e fidelização Acompanhar a performance e necessidades dos parceiros ativos, fortalecendo a parceria e identificando oportunidades de expansão. Atuar como elo entre os parceiros e os setores internos da GVN, no que cabe ao seu serviço prestado, conforme necessidade, para manter a base da empresa e CRM atualizados (Formalização, Comissão, Contencioso, Produto e Qualidade). 3. Análise de mercado e planejamento estratégico Monitorar tendências de mercado, concorrência e movimentações regionais do segmento de crédito consignado. Mapear riscos e oportunidades, propondo estratégias para fortalecimento da presença da sua na região. Contribuir com insights e dados para definição de metas e planos de expansão comercial. Participar, sempre que necessário e conforme disponibilidade própria, de reuniões e treinamentos para ampliar a expertise sobre o mercado. 4. Gestão de indicadores e relatórios Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (produção, inadimplência, rentabilidade, volume de parceiros ativos, etc.) no intuito de ampliar produção da carteira. Elaborar relatórios periódicos de visitas, resultados e feedbacks dos parceiros. Apoiar a GVN com seu conhecimento, na construção de metas e projeções comerciais. Apresentar os riscos das atividades, política e norma NTS e a importância de gerenciar riscos e desenvolver comportamentos seguros. Contribuir com o desenvolvimento de diretrizes e capacitação dos prestadores de serviço para que estejam aptos para lidar com emergências nos projetos da NTS. (Avaliar os Planos de Emergência dos prestadores de serviço dos projetos da NTS) Garantir o gerenciamento eficiente dos incidentes e não conformidades, de modo que ocorrências indesejáveis sejam mitigadas e não voltem a ocorrer. Prestar atendimento humanizado e acolhedor, garantindo conforto, privacidade e segurança durante toda a sessão. Zelar pela higienização adequada de macas, equipamentos, acessórios e materiais utilizados a cada atendimento, seguindo normas de biossegurança. Controlar o uso e reposição de insumos (óleos, cremes, lençóis descartáveis, toalhas), comunicando necessidades de reposição ao responsável. Participar de treinamentos, capacitações e atualizações técnicas promovidas. Contribuir com sugestões de melhoria de processos, fluxos de atendimento e satisfação do paciente. Zelar pela imagem, sigilo e reputação em todas as interações com pacientes, acompanhantes e equipe. vagas.title: Driller - Brazil
vagas.description: The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. The Driller will be conversant with all statutory requirements relating to Well Control and Well Intervention, with all personnel directly or indirectly involved with well operations conforming to the instructions issued by them. Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate, when needed, the Deck Supervisor on his supervision of the deck crew and 3rd Party/vendors on deck Liaise with the Tool Pusher and On Shift Client Representative regarding any changes to the approved well program and communicate these requested changes to all personnel working under their supervision. As delegate of the Rig Superintendent/ Tool Pusher, secure the well in emergency situations and always be aware of environmental aspects. Ensure that the Tool Pusher, Rig Superintendent and Client are advised of all current and/or changing conditions. Under instruction from the Tool Pusher they will conduct Emergency Disconnection Drill to ensure that all personnel are familiar with these operations and record the results in the Operations Daily report. First line is responsible for carrying out the well control and EDS procedures in situations of need emergency disconnect. Under instruction from the Tool pusher usher and or Rig Superintendent they will conduct Well Control Drills. Ensure that well control equipment is correctly maintained, installed and pressure tested. Take direction from the Tool Pusher in all Well Control Operations. Ensure that they have full understanding of the vessel's Well Control Philosophy that includes the current HdB Policies on Well Control & Barriers. Request written dispensation from the tool pusher for any operations that cannot be carried out under the Helix Well Control & Barrier Policies. Conduct Pre-shift, TBT’s, TOFS, Daily drills, & weekly safety meetings with their crew. Ensure that Helix Health & Safety policies are communicated to and understood by all crew members. Ensure that all Supervisors communicate through toolbox meetings, all operational safety aspects of the 12-hour shift. In conjunction with the Tool pusher ensure vessel Well Operations Personnel are being trained to meet the company’s training matrix requirements. Ensure that the appropriate logs and records are maintained throughout their shift. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet daily to discuss previous 24 hours and ongoing operations. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet as and when situations dictate, they are required. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix and Client safety & PPE policies by all personnel working on deck. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix & Statutory Lifting procedures and requirements by all personnel under his supervision. Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. Ensure that operations are carried out in accordance with the latest instruction issued by the OMT with reference to the project documentation where required, and that all personnel under their supervision are clear as regards their role in the forward operation. Complete appraisal for all members of their crew & ensure that it is given to the Tool Pusher or Rig superintendent prior to their departure at the end of each trip. Instigate weekly DROPS inspections, ensuring actions are corrected, reported & logged in the DROPS register. Assist the vessel Maintenance team & Chief Engineer to maintain vessel equipment. Review and as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and JSAs. Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities Tool Pusher for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes. Perform, if required, the same duties as the Assistant Driller. QHSE Following and complying with all the company's health, safety and environment policies, objectives/targets and procedures Minimum Qualifications Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum 3 experience effectively working as a Driller or equivalent in well intervention projects. Qualification As per Helix training and competence directives. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Suporte Submarino
vagas.description: Função desempenhada em operações offshore de águas profundas e ultraprofundas no Brasil, caracterizadas por capacidade limitada do mercado, aumento de custos, requisitos regulatórios rigorosos e forte influência de contratadas. Inserida na função de LSO, apoiando uma ampla gama de atividades offshore, incluindo perfuração, produção, operações submarinas, construção e exploração, além de ativos não operados. Exige interação contínua com partes interessadas internas e contratadas em um ambiente orientado por CMS. Requer forte coordenação transversal com outros departamentos da TEPBR (produção, perfuração, HSE, SC&LC), fornecedores e a Matriz da TotalEnergies. Actividades O(a) funcionário(a) deverá executar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, da reputação da Companhia, na preservação do meio ambiente e na melhoria da eficiência energética e redução das emissões de GEE dos ativos da Companhia. Garantir a conformidade com os padrões de HSE, regulatórios e internos, comunicando claramente as expectativas às equipes de LSO e às contratadas. Fornecer suporte técnico consultivo em operações submarinas, em conformidade com os padrões da Companhia e a regulamentação brasileira, escalando à Matriz quando necessário. Desenvolver e manter procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e especificações técnicas para operações submarinas, incluindo a definição de critérios de aceitação para equipamentos e serviços. Revisar programas de intervenção submarina e validar análises de engenharia relacionadas a atividades complexas de ROV, mergulho e survey. Avaliar análises de risco e processos de Gestão de Mudança (MoC), propondo ações de mitigação e salvaguardas operacionais. Avaliar qualificações técnicas, competências e desempenho de contratadas, contribuindo para processos de seleção e avaliações de desempenho dentro do escopo definido. Realizar visitas a campo e auditorias para verificar a conformidade operacional e promover o alinhamento com LSO, afiliadas e a Matriz. Investigar incidentes, anomalias e não conformidades, assegurando a documentação adequada e recomendando ações corretivas e preventivas, incluindo a disseminação de lições aprendidas (REX). Ministrar treinamentos e realizar coaching com o pessoal sobre procedimentos e requisitos de HSE. Responsabilidades Garantir que todas as operações submarinas sejam executadas de forma segura, eficiente e em total conformidade com os padrões da Companhia, princípios One Maestro e regulamentações aplicáveis. Fornecer recomendações técnicas e soluções para desafios operacionais no domínio submarino. Monitorar e validar o desempenho das contratadas, incluindo o acompanhamento de planos de ação e resultados de Supplier Quality Management (SQM). Revisar e validar dados operacionais relacionados a inspeções, incidentes, não conformidades e ações corretivas. Impulsionar a melhoria contínua de procedimentos, equipamentos e controles operacionais com base em análises, auditorias e lições aprendidas (REX), influenciando as partes interessadas para a implementação das ações acordadas. Formação Graduação em Engenharia ou equivalente. Experiência Mais de 10 anos em atividades offshore de óleo e gás, incluindo operações submarinas (ROV, mergulho e survey) em ambientes regulados. Competências Técnicas Conhecimento de processos contratuais e de normas locais e internacionais (IOGP, IMCA, NORSOK, API, ISO, LOLER, NORMAM 222, ANP SSGS). Forte capacidade de tomada de decisão em HSE e operações. Domínio de ferramentas padrão de escritório. Competências Comportamentais Comunicação técnica clara. Influência transversal. Tomada de decisão orientada a riscos. Resolução estruturada de problemas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Service Lead (Suporte AMS)

A empresa destaca-se pela solidez no mercado e pela proximidade com seus clientes. Service Lead AMS SAP Ariba para fazer parte da nossa equipe do Brasil. Pré requisitos específicos para cliente inicial: 100% Presencial no RJ (região central) Vivência comprovada na liderança de equipes de SAP Ariba Custo presencial (alimentação e deslocamento devem ser por conta do profissional) Principais Atividades (Hard Skills) Gestão de Operação: Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs de atendimento (Incidências, Requisições de Serviço e Problemas) e gerenciar a fila de chamados do ecossistema SAP Ariba (SLp, Sourcing, Contracts, Buying, Commerce Automation). Liderança de Equipe: Coordenar e capacitar o time de consultores (Juniores, Plenos e Seniores), distribuindo demandas de forma eficiente e equilibrando a capacidade da equipe alocada. Gestão de Indicadores e Relatórios: Consolidar e analisar volumetrias, causas‑raiz de incidentes recorrentes e volumetria de horas consumidas, conduzindo reuniões periódicas de comitê operacional e executivo, oferecendo relatórios de análise do serviço e ambiente do cliente (principais problemas atuais, sugestão de melhorias estratégicas, roadmap de solução) Melhoria Contínua e Evolutivos: Identificar gargalos nos processos de compras do cliente e propor melhorias (Enhancements ou pequenas melhorias contratuais), impulsionando a adoção de novas releases trimestrais da SAP Cloud pelo time do cliente. Qualidades e Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills) Orientação a Dados e Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de analisar cenários através de indicadores, identificando problemas operacionais antes que virem crises. Comunicação Executiva e Resiliência: Habilidade para traduzir problemas técnicos complexos em linguagem de negócios para gestores e diretores, mantendo o controle em situações de criticidade (ex: indisponibilidade de compras). Gestão de Conflitos e Negociação: Equilíbrio para gerenciar prioridades concorrentes entre o que o negócio do cliente demanda e a capacidade real do time de AMS. Foco no Cliente: Proatividade para entender o impacto de um chamado parado na cadeia de suprimentos do cliente (impacto em fábrica, fornecedores, etc.), indo além do simples cumprimento do SLA. Liderança Servidora: Habilidade para apoiar o time técnico, blindando os consultores de pressões externas indevidas e garantindo as ferramentas necessárias para a execução do trabalho (acessos à sistemas, disponibilidade de usuários e sistemas do cliente, etc) Informações adicionais Modalidade de contratação: preferencialmente Cooperado ou PJ . #J-18808-Ljbffr
